snippets.name: Open current folder
snippets.description: macOS: open the current directory in Finder.

snippets.name: Show network configuration
snippets.description: macOS: show network interfaces and their addresses.

snippets.name: Look up a domain
snippets.description: Query DNS for example.com. Replace the domain as needed.

snippets.name: Copy current path
snippets.description: macOS: copy the current directory path to the clipboard.

snippets.name: Show Git working tree changes
snippets.description: Requires Git: show a short summary of changes in the current Git repository.

snippets.name: Show 256-color palette
snippets.description: Zsh or Bash: clear the screen and display all 256 indexed terminal colors.
snippets.body: clear ; echo ; for i in {0..255}; do [[ $((i%8)) -eq 0 ]] && echo; printf '\e[38;5;0m\e[48;5;%dm  %03d  \e[0m' "$i" "$i"; done; echo -e '\n' ;
